about: The units this package computes with, by type key (docs/escaping-the-gpl.md). A unit registered for a type key (bylonder/units.js register) runs in place of what the package ships; a replaced unit ships nothing and its entities stay baked until one is registered.

interface.icons: Record<string, [svg: string, width: number, height: number]>

uses.what: Blender's compositor GLSL made at export, in scene.js
